description:
**Wanted:** the owner ran `/clear` at the desk and the agent's conversation in Foreman showed nothing (Chat Notes, 2026-11-03): "there's nothing in the foreman messages with the agents to indicate that the context is cleared. Ideally, muster has a better visibility into this kind of stuff and thus can also provide it to foreman."

The API gives a pane's `session` and `facts.context_used`, and no event for either change. A client could only guess from `context_used` falling or `session` changing. Not checked: whether `session` changes on `/clear`, which a_2jSDHoYDD believed and did not verify. Compaction keeps the session.

**Proposed:** an event on the API's watch stream with the pane, the kind (cleared, compacted) and the time, so a client can mark the moment in a conversation.
title: API: say when an agent's context was cleared or compacted
